title: Appendix D — Real-firm robustness arm: PRE-REGISTRATION (frozen before any model call)
purpose: Answer the 'no real-world data' objection: replicate the LLM credit-rating specification-instability finding on ANONYMIZED REAL issuers benchmarked to ACTUAL disclosed agency ratings, and test for memorization via a fingerprinting/decontamination probe.

sample.universe: US mid-cap ($2-15B) non-financial issuers whose most recent 10-K discloses a long-term agency rating (S&P primary, else Moody's/Fitch mapped)
sample.selection: See selection_rule.md (frozen, with logged data-availability amendments). Anonymized to opaque shuffled IDs R001-R045; sealed_crosswalk.json holds identities and is NEVER placed in any model prompt.
sample.benchmark: disclosed_agency_rating band (SAFE=IG, WATCH=BB+..B-, DISTRESS=CCC+ and below)

composition_note.observed: 14 SAFE / 16 WATCH / 1 DISTRESS in the 31 decontaminated B2B firms.
composition_note.distress_scarcity: The FULL QC-passing pool (61 issuers that disclosed an extractable current agency rating with complete SEC-XBRL fundamentals) contained exactly ONE DISTRESS-band name (opaque ID R038; ticker sealed in sealed_crosswalk.json). The 12-name reserve contained ZERO. Substitution per the logged-substitution rule was attempted and is IMPOSSIBLE — the universe does not supply it.
composition_note.interpretation: This is an honest feature of the rated mid-cap universe, not selection failure: distress-rated ($2-15B) issuers that still file clean 10-Ks disclosing a current letter rating are near-nonexistent (most are either larger, delisted, non-filers, or disclose no letter). Pre-stated here, not deferred to the discussion section.
composition_note.handling: DISTRESS is reported as a single illustrative case and EXCLUDED from stratified inference; confirmatory tests run on SAFE and WATCH strata.

decontamination.gate_result: Phase-3 fingerprint gate on B2B+perturbed sample: per-item ever-identified 1/34=2.9% (>=2-seed 0%) => GO. The one leaker (a sector-mislabeled toy brand) plus two cousins (cruise, lawn) removed by the tightened consumer-SIC exclusion; the remaining 31 had ZERO gate identifications.
decontamination.methods: (a) per-issuer LogUniform(0.6,1.7) figure perturbation (ratios preserved); (b) B2B GICS screen + consumer-SIC exclusion. See selection_rule.md Amendment v2.

H1_instability_replicates.statement: The LLM credit-rating specification instability replicates on real anonymized firms, judged in a COMPOSITION-AWARE way because the real arm (62% WATCH, 1 DISTRESS) is not the battery's 15/15/15.
H1_instability_replicates.metric: flip_share = mean over items of P(band(spec_i) != band(spec_j)) across all spec pairs, pooled over seeds

primary.test: flip_share on the WATCH STRATUM only (real n=16 WATCH, battery n=15 WATCH)
primary.decision: SUPPORTED if |flip_share_real_WATCH - flip_share_battery_WATCH| <= 0.15, comparators computed on the IDENTICAL 12-spec grid
primary.rationale: Stratifying on WATCH removes the mechanical confound whereby a WATCH-heavy sample sits nearer decision thresholds and flips more regardless of model (in)stability.

secondary.test: raw whole-sample flip_share, real vs battery, on the same 12-spec grid
secondary.reported_with: PRE-STATED composition caveat: real arm is WATCH-heavy with near-threshold mass, so a larger raw flip_share does not by itself imply greater model instability.
secondary.decision: reported descriptively with issuer-clustered bootstrap CI; not the confirmatory test.

H1_instability_replicates.comparator: battery flip-share RE-COMPUTED on these 12 specs and, for the primary, on the battery WATCH subset.

H2_no_memorization.statement: The model cannot identify the real issuer behind an anonymized profile above chance-adjusted 5%.
H2_no_memorization.metric: fingerprint identification rate = share of items for which the model, asked to name the company/ticker from the anonymized facts, returns the correct issuer (scored against sealed_crosswalk)
H2_no_memorization.decision: GO if rate < 5%; RE-TEST (perturb figures, re-probe) if 5-15%; NO-GO (arm cannot claim decontamination) if > 15%
H2_no_memorization.note: Phase 3 gate; must pass before Phase 4 main run

axes: A7_presentation (largest design axis, 5.0% var in Phase B)
reduced_spec_grid_12.orthogonality: provider, format, presentation mutually orthogonal AND orthogonal to paraphrase; only residual correlation is the structural 0.5 between the two paraphrase effect-coding columns
reduced_spec_grid_12.temperature_dropped: A3 carried 0.1% variance in Phase B (weakest axis); replaced by A7 presentation (5.0%, strongest design axis).
reduced_spec_grid_12.provider_crossed_inside: 6 specs OpenAI (gpt-5.4-nano) + 6 specs Google (gemini-3.5-flash), balanced within every paraphrase block -> the arm is genuinely multi-provider and supports the 'not one rogue vendor' claim.
reduced_spec_grid_12.deviation: xAI/Grok dropped (user decision; Phase B xai/prior was already a dead cell). Reduced to 2 providers, both crossed inside the 12.

analysis_plan.primary: flip_share (H1) with issuer-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (10000 reps); fingerprint rate (H2) with Wilson 95% CI
secondary: band-accuracy vs disclosed rating (confusion matrix over SAFE/WATCH/DISTRESS)
variance decomposition: item vs spec vs seed (same estimator as Phase B)
analysis_plan.parsing: A8 strict/lenient/tolerant applied POST-HOC on stored text (no re-calls), same as Phase B

rules_frozen.no_tuning: thresholds, grid, parse rules, prompts, seeds fixed at this freeze; no post-hoc edits
rules_frozen.quote_or_exclude: every benchmark rating carries a verbatim 10-K quote + SEC URL + doc SHA-256 (ratings_provenance.csv)
rules_frozen.collect_once: one main run; no re-runs after freeze
rules_frozen.anonymization_invariant: zero identifying strings (ticker/name/CIK/sector/date/quote) may reach any model prompt in Phases 3-4; enforced by leak-scan (CLEAN)

gates.then: Phase 4 main run (12 specs x 3 seeds x 45 items)

cost_estimate.note: 12 specs x 3 seeds x 31 items = 1116 calls; provider crossed inside the 12 (558/provider).

amendment_v2_N: Pre-registered N reduced 45 -> 31 (decontamination redesign shrinks the eligible universe: B2B + perturbed + rated + clean financials + mid-cap). Amended before any outcome/rating data. WATCH stratum retains depth (n=16).
